note: Real screens of the reference instance (guide/reference, http://localhost:8480) for the LB additions (0.13 LB), light theme, 1440 px wide, taken by guide/tools/screens.mjs (--file LB.screens.json) into guide/public/screens/<name>.png. 'model-layout-table-tab' retakes the existing picture so it shows the Inactive records… button, on the type Stop of the model draft 'Guide draft for the LB pictures' (id 9d3cedd9-9f0b-46b0-971d-8addd66c5a68, made through New draft from 1.8.2 on the model's page, recreate it and put its id in the URL to retake; the layout tab only changes the draft when a dialog is applied, and none is). The two matrix screens use the Operators by language matrix of Names: Hide empty columns is a per-browser setting, so each run starts with it off. Nothing is saved. NOT taken, because the reference model has nothing for them (no yes/no attribute on any listed type, no application with more than ten sidebar entries): the sidebar Find a list, an inactive table with Hide inactive, and the Inactive records… dialog with a field chosen.
